Islamism is a range of religious and political ideological movements that believe that Islam should influence political systems. [ 1 ] Its proponents believe Islam is innately political, and that Islam as a political system is superior to communism , liberal democracy , capitalism , and other alternatives in achieving a just, successful society. [ 2 ] The advocates of Islamism, also known as al-Islamiyyun , are usually affiliated with Islamic institutions or social mobilization movements, [ 3 ] emphasizing the implementation of sharia , [ 4 ] pan-Islamic political unity, [ 4 ] and the creation of Islamic states . [ 5 ]
